text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the cafeteria to have 
lunch—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, tell me! I sweeeear I won't tell 
a soul~~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'm telling you, you're asking the 
wrong person...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"—Ah... no, Mayano was just talking 
nonsense."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Because, because! Nature-chan, you've been 
shining so bright lately!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Her running style got all whooshy, and 
she's smiling every day... Something 
definitely happened!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No... First off, it's not sparkling at 
all. It feels like I'm just being talked 
into this..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You know, is it Trainer-san's skill at 
work? It just makes me feel like giving it 
my all, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, is that all? When you think of a girl 
shining bright, it's gotta be~~...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "...Gasp!! O-Oh, is that how it is?!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa☆ I'm getting so excited! Maya won't 
lose to those two either, I'll do my best♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hah!? Pounding heart!? W-Wait, what are 
you――

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, Mayano!! You've totally got the 
wrong idea! I said waaaaait!!"

...I don't fully understand it, but the 
coaching for Nice Nature is definitely 
showing results!
